blocks.text: Photosynthesis mein CO₂ ko reduce karne ke liye hydrogen pani se aata hai. Photosynthesis mein nikalne wali oxygen bhi pani se aati hai, is liye pani hawa ki oxygen ka aham zariya hai, jo zyada tar jandaron ko aerobic respiration aur zinda rehne ki tawanai ke liye chahiye.

blocks.alt: Do poday. Group 1 ke podon ko bhari oxygen wala pani, H2(18)O, aur aam CO2 diya jata hai, aur woh bhari oxygen (18)O2 chhorte hain. Group 2 ke podon ko aam pani aur C(18)O2 diya jata hai, aur woh aam O2 chhorte hain. Neeche do masawaat (equations): 6CO2 + 12H2(18)O se C6H12O6 + 6H2O + 6(18)O2; aur 6C(18)O2 + 12H2O se C6H12(18)O6 + 6H2(18)O + 6O2; bhari oxygen ke atoms rangeen hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3: Tajurba jo sabit karta hai ke photosynthesis mein nikalne wali oxygen ka zariya pani hai (kitab ki Figure 5.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 1930 ki dahai mein Van Niel ne mafrooza diya ke poda hydrogen hasil karne ke liye pani ko torta hai aur oxygen zimni product (by-product) ke taur par nikalti hai. 1940 ki dahai mein scientists ne is ki tasdeeq ki. Is tajurbe mein oxygen ka isotopic tracer (¹⁸O, bhari oxygen) istemal hua. Laboratory mein bhari oxygen wala pani H₂¹⁸O aur bhari oxygen wali carbon dioxide C¹⁸O₂ tayyar ki gayi. Pehle group ke podon ko H₂¹⁸O aur aam CO₂ (C¹⁶O₂) di gayi. Doosre group ko C¹⁸O₂ aur aam pani (H₂¹⁶O) diya gaya. Dono ko photosynthesis ka mahol diya gaya aur nikalne wali oxygen jama kar ke jaanchi gayi. Pehle group ne ¹⁸O chhori aur doosre group ne aam oxygen (¹⁶O). Is se sabit hua ke nikalne wali oxygen pani se aati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “Van Neil” aur “Neil’s hypothesis” chhapa hai; scientist ka sahi naam C. B. van Niel (Cornelis van Niel) hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rangeen O bhari oxygen (18-O) hai. Group 1 mein bhari oxygen sirf pani mein thi aur wohi hawa mein nikli. Group 2 mein bhari oxygen CO₂ mein thi, magar nikalne wali oxygen aam thi; CO₂ ki oxygen glucose aur naye pani mein gayi. Is liye nikalne wali oxygen pani se aati hai.

Photosynthesis mein pani toot kar hydrogen deta hai. Yeh hydrogen coenzyme nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADP) ko reduce kar ke NADPH banata hai. Yahi NADPH CO₂ ko sugar mein badalne ke liye “reducing power” (reduce karne ki taqat) ka kaam karta hai.
